title: Debiased lasso

  1. (Decomposition.) 𝛃n(b^−β)=w+r, where 𝛆w=Θ^X⊤ε/n∼Np(0,σ2Θ^Σ^Θ^⊤) exactly, and 𝛃𝛃r=−n(Θ^Σ^−I)(β^λ−β).

  2. (Remainder.) 𝛃𝛃|rj|≤nμj‖β^λ−β‖1. If λ≥2λ0, ϕ2(S)>0 and T occurs, then |rj|≤4nμjλs/ϕ2(S).

  3. (Variance.) If μj<1, then 𝛉𝛉ωj2=θ^j⊤Σ^θ^j≥(1−μj)2.

  4. (Asymptotic normality.) Consider a sequence of such problems with n→∞, in which p, s, X, 𝛃β and Θ^ may change with n and σ is fixed. Suppose λ=2λ0 with δ=δn→0 and log⁡(1/δn)=O(log⁡p); ϕ2(S)≥ϕ02>0; μj≤Clog⁡p/n for a constant C; slog⁡p/n→0; and σ^/σ→1 in probability. Then Tj=n(b^j−βj)σ^ωj → N(0,1)in distribution,{#eq-hd-debiased-t}
